item.title: Toledo councilmen frustrated after grant program for water bills went unspent
item.description: Toledo City Council is being asked to authorize funding for a grant program to help customers with past due water bills, but some members expressed concerns after learning that no one benefited from the program last year.

item.title: TPS board of education approves budget forecast
item.description: Facing projected losses of tens of millions of dollars, the Toledo Public Schools Board of Education unanimously approved a four-year budget forecast Tuesday night that outlines deep cuts and shrinking cash reserves.

item.title: Perrysburg’s Madigan places 2nd in state diving
item.description: CANTON — Several local athletes were in action on Tuesday at the OHSAA boys diving state championships.

item.title: Offensive tackle Taylor Decker will return to Lions for 11th season
item.description: DETROIT — Detroit Lions offensive tackle Taylor Decker has decided to return for an 11th season.

item.title: U.S. women's gold medal-winning team declined invitation from Trump to attend State of Union address
item.description: WASHINGTON — The U.S. women's hockey gold medal-winning team has politely declined an invitation from President Donald Trump to attend his State of the Union address on Tuesday.

item.title: Home loss to Western Michigan keeps BGSU men's basketball on MAC bubble
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — Western Michigan pulled away in the final 8½ minutes Tuesday to defeat the Bowling Green State University men’s basketball team 88-79 at the Stroh Center, keeping the Falcons’ Mid-American Conference tournament hopes in flux.

item.title: Video: Trump uses longest-ever State of the Union to try to convince voters that U.S. is 'winning so much'
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump declared during Tuesday's marathon State of the Union that “we’re winning so much,” saying he'd sparked a jobs and manufacturing boom at home while imposing a new world order abroad — hoping that offering a long list of his accomplishments can counter approval ratings that have been falling.

item.title: Anthony Wayne, Start win rematches in Division II district girls basketball semifinals
item.description: MILLBURY, Ohio — The familiar matchups in Tuesday’s Division II district girls basketball semifinals at Lake High School ended in similar fashion from the regular-season showdowns.

item.title: High school basketball: Local girls teams secure spots in district finals
item.description: Liberty-Benton was among several local girls basketball teams that advanced in the district playoffs on Tuesday, as the Eagles defeated Wauseon 43-32 in Division IV Northwest 1.
